title: Maps
subtitle: Your custom map library. A map replaces a Labs arena; the original is backed up and comes back in one click. Works while the game runs, from the main menu.

import.folderTitle: Import a folder of maps (e.g. a BakkesMod Workshop folder)

session.autoRestore: the stock arena comes back when the game closes

library.search: Search by name, author or tag
library.dropHint: Tip: drag & drop files or folders anywhere
library.emptyDescription: Import .upk/.zip files, a Workshop folder, or download maps from the Browse tab.

card.installHintLive: Swap now — go back to the main menu first if you are on this arena
